description_expanded: ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Wooden beams and framing have been installed on the balconies as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures partially reduce the views from the balconies, including the pool area.30A ESCAPES presents… “Texas Two Step,” a stylish 3rd floor condo at The Pointe on 30A featuring 2 bedrooms, a built-in bunk area, two private balconies, upscale interiors, and resort-style amenities—all just a 5-min walk to beach access and Rosemary Town Center. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town CenterTwo Private Balconies: Ideal for coffee, cocktails, or quiet retreatBunk Area: Twin-over-twin built-in beds perfect for kidsSpacious Layout: Open concept kitchen, living, and dining areasUpscale Kitchen: Quartz counters, stainless appliances, island seating for 4Two Comfortable Bedrooms with spa-inspired bathroomsResort Amenities: Pool, hot tub, fire pits, grills, and fitness centerOn-Site Dining: 'Big Bad Breakfast' for brunch favoritesBikes Included: 2 adult bikes for exploring 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a bright, coastal-inspired living space that flows seamlessly to the private balcony. Whether you're relaxing after the beach or enjoying a movie night, this open layout is perfect for families and small groups.Open-concept living and dining areaFlat screen TV and comfortable furnishingsAccess to private balcony with outdoor seating*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Enjoy preparing meals in the fully equipped kitchen with quartz countertops and modern appliances. An island with bar seating and an open layout make it easy to entertain and connect.Full-size kitchen with stainless steel appliancesQuartz countertops and generous cabinetryIsland with seating for 4Balcony dining table with seating for 4—perfect for al fresco meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Enjoy two private balconies—perfect for al fresco meals, morning coffee, or evening cocktails. These outdoor spaces are an extension of your living area and a great way to enjoy the Florida breeze.Two private balconies with lounge seating and diningResort-style pool and oversized hot tubGas grills, fire pits, and shaded lounge areasOn-site restaurant ‘Big Bad Breakfast’*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite: King-size bed, flat screen TV, En-suite with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities and private balcony accessQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, En-suite with walk-in shower and dual vanitiesBunk Area: Twin-over-twin built-in bunk bed in the entryway*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located near Rosemary and Inlet Beach, this condo places you at the heart of 30A’s most desirable attractions. Spend your days exploring boutique shops and dining at 30Avenue, wandering the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, or adventuring through the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park, where hiking trails and coastal dune lakes await.5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town Center5-minute walk to Winston Lane Public Beach AccessSteps to ‘Big Bad Breakfast’ and other local favorites2-minute bike ride to 30Avenue—shopping, dining, and seasonal events10-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park—hiking, paddling, and natural beauty*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesWooden beams and framing have been installed on the balconies as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures partially reduce views from the balconies, including the pool area.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 211124
